title: Elf Bar 600 Pineapple Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pods are designed for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a tropical fruit blend with a cooling twist. Each pack contains two 2ml pods preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, with each pod lasting up to 600 puffs depending on use. Their inhale-activated design makes vaping simple, producing a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw without the need for buttons, coil changes, or refilling. This flavour captures the juicy sweetness of ripe Pineapple, finished with an icy chill that lifts the fruit’s natural tang. The combination is both sweet and brisk, delivering a flavour that tastes refreshing and bright from beginning to end. Once a pod runs out, replacing it is quick and clean — just click a new one into your kit and continue.
